c.tagline: A Roman amphitheatre by the Adriatic and the gateway to Istria's beaches and vineyards.

taxi.fareNote: Metered taxis are available; Uber and Bolt both operate in Pula and are usually cheaper, especially for the short run to the airport.

emergency.note: 112 is the EU-wide emergency number connecting to police, fire and ambulance; 192 reaches police directly and 194 the ambulance.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: Only minor pickpocketing risk in peak-summer crowds around the Arena, market and waterfront.

hood_desc: The historic core wrapped around the Roman Arena, the Forum with the Temple of Augustus and the hilltop Kaštel fortress; a compact tangle of squares, cafes and Roman monuments that is the best base for first-time visitors.
A green peninsula ~4 km south of the center packed with the big resort hotels, pools and pebble-and-rock swimming spots; the go-to area for a beach-and-family holiday.
A leafy peninsula neighborhood of family houses, a large campsite, beaches like Galebove stijene and Pula's biggest shopping mall; tranquil yet close to the center.
A lively bayside district around Veruda marina with waterfront restaurants, bars and residential streets just south of downtown; good for dining and nightlife near the water.
A residential hillside suburb between the center and the beaches, quieter and cheaper, with apartments and easy bus links; suits travelers wanting a local, calm base.

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink throughout Croatia.

transit.hours: City buses run roughly 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM with reduced frequency on Sundays; taxis and ride apps cover late nights.
transit.note: Pula has no tram or metro; the compact old town is walkable and Pulapromet city buses connect the center with the beaches, suburbs and the airport.
transit.pay: Buy tickets from the driver in cash or at kiosks; contactless card payment is accepted on many buses. Uber and Bolt are paid in-app.

bus: Intercity coaches to Rovinj, Rijeka, Zagreb and Trieste from the main bus station
ferry: Seasonal catamarans to Venice, Zadar and the Kvarner islands
Boats to the Brijuni islands from nearby Fažana
train: Limited regional rail via Kanfanar toward Rijeka (with a bus connection)

transit.m: Airport shuttle bus to the main bus station (~15 min, timed to flights)
Taxi to the city center (10-15 min)

tip.r: Not obligatory; rounding up the bill or leaving 5-10% for good service in restaurants is appreciated but not expected.
